title: Lifting a map from a bounded projective complex through a map that is a cohomology isomorphism above degree n
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $n\in\mathbf Z$. Let $P^\bullet$ be a bounded complex of projective $R$-modules with $P^i=0$ for $i<n$, let $E^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet$ be complexes of $R$-modules, and let $\alpha:E^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ and $\beta:P^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ be morphisms in $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] such that $H^i(\alpha)$ is an isomorphism for $i>n$ and surjective for $i=n$. Then there is a morphism of complexes $\gamma:P^\bullet\to E^\bullet$ with $\alpha\circ Q(\gamma)=\beta$ in $D(R)$, where $Q$ is the localization functor of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].
